## Instructions

This project asks you to develop a short empirical analysis using methods from the first half of the course. You should:

1. Identify a political science research question
2. State a testable hypothesis
3. Describe your data and variables
4. Estimate and interpret an appropriate regression model
5. Present your results with tables and/or figures

**Length:** 8--10 pages (excluding tables and figures)

**Format:** Quarto document rendered to PDF
